family.description: The mycobacterial members of this family are expressed from part of the ergothioneine biosynthetic gene cluster. EGTD is the histidine methyltransferase that transfers three methyl groups to the alpha-amino moiety of histidine, in the first stage of the production of this histidine betaine derivative that carries a thiol group attached to the C2 atom of an imidazole ring [[cite:PUB00060032]].
family.name: Histidine-specific methyltransferase, SAM-dependent
